cards.title: Finite-range disordered Hamiltonian
cards.role: Fixes hopping orientation, onsite disorder, and boundary matrices.

checks.reason: Equation label model in the TeX source.
M=2 gives two upper and two lower hopping diagonals.

cards.title: M=2 one-site transfer matrix
cards.role: Propagates the same eigen-equation as the finite Hamiltonian by one site.

checks.reason: Appendix S3 gives the general 2M one-site companion matrix.
Rearranging the row-i eigen-equation gives the recorded first row.

cards.title: Lyapunov spectrum and clean beta-root limit
cards.latex: gamma_s=lim_{L to infinity} eig[(2L)^{-1} ln(T^dagger T)]_s; gamma_s=ln|beta_s| at W=0
cards.role: Defines the ordered state vector behind every Lyapunov prediction.

checks.reason: Main text defines the product; Appendix S3 proves the clean beta-root limit.
Periodic QR evaluates asymptotic growth; the clean case is checked against log|beta|.

open_questions: The arXiv source does not report transfer length or QR interval; the formal supplement confirms periodic QR but not the interval.

cards.title: OBC non-Hermitian Thouless relation
cards.role: Predicts OBC potential and density from the M largest exponents.

checks.reason: Main-text Eqs. pot_obc/den_obc, derived in Appendix S1.

In the reproduced paper regime, the M-largest-exponent density overlaps independently diagonalized OBC spectra by 0.806917; a stable finite-spectrum log-determinant test also verifies the finite observable. This is target-regime validation, not a claim of a new general theorem proof.

cards.title: PBC non-Hermitian Thouless relation
cards.role: Predicts PBC potential and density from the positive exponents.

checks.reason: Main-text Eqs. pot_pbc/den_pbc, derived in Appendix S2.

In the reproduced paper regime, the positive-exponent density overlaps independently diagonalized PBC spectra by 0.849765, while direct twist winding and Lyapunov winding agree in spectral holes. This is target-regime validation, not a claim of a new general theorem proof.

cards.title: Essential Lyapunov exponent and mobility edge
cards.role: Centralizes the ALM/skin/UCS transition rule and mobility-edge contour.

checks.reason: Main-text Eqs. ess/mobility.
Opposite central signs are ALM, zero is the boundary, same signs are skin.

cards.title: Winding number from positive Lyapunov count
cards.role: Defines the integer topological criterion for skin versus ALM.

checks.reason: Eq. winding2 is proved via transfer-matrix duality in Appendix S5.
For M=2, M-n_P is integer and vanishes exactly when two exponents are positive.

cards.title: Anderson-localized fraction
cards.role: Summarizes the transition as the fraction of OBC states with opposite-sign central exponents.

checks.reason: Definition immediately before Fig. 5 in the main text.
Normalized density times a binary ALM indicator gives 0<=alpha<=1.

open_questions: The paper does not report the Fig. 5(b) ensemble and quadrature details.

cards.title: Nearest-neighbour transfer recurrence for the supplemental Hatano-Nelson models
cards.role: Fixes the forward denominator and backward numerator shared by the Fig. S1/S2 transfer and ED paths.

checks.reason: Published supplement Eqs. S32-S33 place t+gamma on H[j,j+1] and t-gamma on H[j,j-1].
Independent tests substitute one transfer step back into the matching ED Hamiltonian row for both models.

cards.title: Unidirectional OBC density identity
cards.latex: H_{OBC}=diag(w_1,...,w_L)+t_1 S_+ implies spec(H_{OBC})={w_i}; therefore rho_{OBC}=rho_w
cards.role: Turns the independent main-text limiting claim into an analytic and finite numerical target.

checks.reason: The paragraph after Fig. 4 states the one-way nearest-neighbour OBC limit and rho_OBC=rho_w.
With only one OBC hopping direction the Hamiltonian is triangular and its eigenvalues equal its onsite diagonal.

cards.title: Fig. S3 arithmetic-precision deviation
cards.role: Defines the matched-precision ED/QR benchmark against the published 256-bit ED reference contract.

checks.reason: Published Fig. S3 and its caption define the two energies, four precisions, L=1000, 1600 samples, and 256-bit ED reference.
Arbitrary-precision dense ED and modified-Gram-Schmidt QR both return finite potentials on the same frozen small chain.

cards.numerical_form: run_precision_pilot at configured bit depths and energies
open_questions: The paper-scale L=1000 x 1600 arbitrary-precision ED sweep is code-ready but exceeds the measured local budget.

cards.title: Fig. S4 finite-size Lyapunov-gap deviation
cards.role: Defines the plotted gap-deviation series and its exponential-versus-algebraic model comparison.

checks.reason: Published Fig. S4 and its caption define E0, L=50 through 400, and the L=1000 reference, while omitting the disorder realization protocol.
All configured finite-size gaps and both fit residuals are finite; the code preserves a failed exponential feature instead of tuning it.

cards.numerical_form: run_gap_scaling over L=50..400 with L=1000 reference
open_questions: The published supplement does not state the S4 disorder ensemble size, realization identity, averaging order, or QR interval.
